en.headline: Child abuse cases up sharply since 2020, welfare group says
en.dek: Against Child Abuse said suspected cases rose from 940 in 2020 to 1,354 in 2025, with sexual and physical abuse recorded at the same level for the first time.
body: Against Child Abuse said on Wednesday that suspected child abuse cases in Hong Kong had risen from 940 in 2020 to 1,354 in 2025, describing the trend as alarming and calling for stronger prevention and a review of how mandatory reporting is working.

Citing Social Welfare Department Child Protection Registry figures, the group said the rate of recorded abuse climbed from 0.92 per 1,000 children in 2020 to 1.54 in 2025. Sexual abuse cases reached 501 last year, matching physical abuse for the first time in more than two decades, it said.

Chairperson Patrick Cheung said the rise reflected several factors, including the lingering effects of the Covid-19 period, more time spent online, economic pressure on families and greater public awareness after the Mandatory Reporting of Child Abuse Ordinance took effect in January. The government has said it received 176 reports from specified professionals in the first five months of the law.

Cheung said perpetrators of sexual abuse were often peers or people met on the internet, and the group backed proposals to create an offence of persistent child sexual abuse. It also called for regular reviews of the reporting ordinance, more support for high-risk families, and education on online safety for children.

zh.headline: 防止虐兒會：懸疑虐兒個案五年升至1354宗
zh.dek: 機構引述社署數字，指2025年性侵犯與身體虐待同錄501宗，二十多年來首次持平，促檢視強制舉報成效。
body: 防止虐待兒童會周三表示，本港懸疑虐兒個案由2020年的940宗升至2025年的1354宗，形容升勢令人憂慮，並促請加強預防及檢視強制舉報制度的運作。
機構引述社會福利署保護兒童資料系統數字，指虐兒發生率由2020年每千名兒童0.92宗，升至2025年的1.54宗。去年性侵犯個案錄501宗，與身體虐待宗數相同，是二十多年來首次持平。
該會主席張志雄表示，升幅與新冠疫情影響、網上活動增加、家庭經濟壓力，以及今年1月《強制舉報虐待兒童條例》生效後公眾意識提高有關。政府早前表示，條例實施首五個月接獲指定專業人員176宗舉報。
張志雄指，性侵犯施害者不少是同輩或在網上認識的人，該會支持訂立持續性侵犯兒童罪，並促請定期檢視舉報條例成效、加強支援高風險家庭，以及向兒童推廣網上安全教育。
